```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Global chunk options
# echo = TRUE:     show code in rendered output
# warning = FALSE: suppress warnings in rendered document
#                  (warnings still print to console during knitting)
# message = FALSE: suppress package loading messages
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width  = 10,
  fig.height = 6,
  dpi        = 300
)

# save_plot(): writes a figure to PDF (outputs folder) and shows the same figure in the knitted HTML.
# The plotting code is run once for the PDF and once for a PNG copy at the same size, which is embedded in
# the HTML; when run interactively (not knitting) the plot is also drawn in the plot pane.
save_plot <- function(file, width, height, expr) {
  expr <- substitute(expr); env <- parent.frame()
  # draw on a newly opened device and close exactly that device (never whichever device happens to be current).
  # Some plotting functions move drawing away from that device: pheatmap() opens and closes a temporary device
  # (pdf(NULL) ... dev.off()) before drawing, and R then makes some other open device current, which left PDFs blank or
  # missing from the HTML. RStudio/knitr graphics hooks can do the same. While the file is drawn, those hooks are
  # replaced by one that switches back to the file's device each time a new plot page starts (plot.new / grid.newpage).
  hooks <- c("before.plot.new", "plot.new", "before.grid.newpage", "grid.newpage")
  draw_on <- function(open_device) {
    saved <- lapply(setNames(hooks, hooks), getHook)
    open_device(); d <- dev.cur()
    back_to_d <- function() if (d %in% dev.list() && dev.cur() != d) dev.set(d)
    for (h in hooks) setHook(h, NULL, "replace")
    setHook("before.plot.new", back_to_d); setHook("before.grid.newpage", back_to_d)
    on.exit({ if (d %in% dev.list()) dev.off(d)
              for (h in hooks) setHook(h, saved[[h]], "replace") })
    eval(expr, env)
  }
  draw_on(function() pdf(file = file, width = width, height = height))
  if (!isTRUE(getOption("knitr.in.progress"))) { # interactive: also draw in the plot pane (skipped if the pane is too small)
    ok <- try(eval(expr, env), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(ok, "try-error") && dev.cur() > 1)
      try(dev.off(dev.cur()), silent = TRUE) # reset the screen device left in a broken state (the PDF is already closed)
    return(invisible(file)) }
  png_file <- file.path(tempdir(), sub("\\.pdf$", ".png", basename(file)))
  draw_on(function() png(png_file, width = width, height = height, units = "in", res = 150))
  if (!file.exists(png_file)) { warning("nothing was drawn for ", basename(file)); return(invisible(file)) }
  knitr::include_graphics(png_file, rel_path = FALSE, dpi = 150) # displayed at its true size
}
```


# packages

```{r packages}
# install.packages("KOGMWU")
library(KOGMWU)
library(pheatmap) # pheatmap() is used for the delta-rank heatmaps below

# loading KOG annotations
gene2kog=read.table("../../../Orbicella-faveolata-annotated-transcriptome/Ofaveolata_iso2kogClass.tab",sep="\t", fill=T)
head(gene2kog)
```

```{r treatment-all}
LC_CC=load('../../outputs/transcriptomics/ofav/limma/LC_CC_lpv.RData')
LC_CC # names of datasets in the package
LC_CC.p <- LC_CC.p[!is.na(LC_CC.p$lpv), ] # drop genes with NA lpv (e.g. padj = NA from independent filtering)
lpv.LC_CC=kog.mwu(LC_CC.p,gene2kog) 
lpv.LC_CC 

CH_CC=load('../../outputs/transcriptomics/ofav/limma/CH_CC_lpv.RData')

LH_CC=load('../../outputs/transcriptomics/ofav/limma/LH_CC_lpv.RData')
LH_CC # names of datasets in the package
LH_CC.p <- LH_CC.p[!is.na(LH_CC.p$lpv), ] # drop genes with NA lpv (e.g. padj = NA from independent filtering)
lpv.LH_CC=kog.mwu(LH_CC.p,gene2kog) 
lpv.LH_CC 

CH_LC=load('../../outputs/transcriptomics/ofav/limma/CH_LC_lpv.RData')
CH_LC # names of datasets in the package
CH_LC.p <- CH_LC.p[!is.na(CH_LC.p$lpv), ] # drop genes with NA lpv (e.g. padj = NA from independent filtering)
lpv.CH_LC=kog.mwu(CH_LC.p,gene2kog) 
lpv.CH_LC

LH_LC=load('../../outputs/transcriptomics/ofav/limma/LH_LC_lpv.RData')
LH_LC # names of datasets in the package
LH_LC.p <- LH_LC.p[!is.na(LH_LC.p$lpv), ] # drop genes with NA lpv (e.g. padj = NA from independent filtering)
lpv.LH_LC=kog.mwu(LH_LC.p,gene2kog) 
lpv.LH_LC

LH_CH=load('../../outputs/transcriptomics/ofav/limma/LH_CH_lpv.RData')
LH_CH # names of datasets in the package
LH_CH.p <- LH_CH.p[!is.na(LH_CH.p$lpv), ] # drop genes with NA lpv (e.g. padj = NA from independent filtering)
lpv.LH_CH=kog.mwu(LH_CH.p,gene2kog) 
lpv.LH_CH

# compiling a table of delta-ranks to compare these results:
ktable=makeDeltaRanksTable(list("LC_CC"=lpv.LC_CC,"CH_CC"=lpv.CH_CC,"LH_CC"=lpv.LH_CC,"CH_LC"=lpv.CH_LC,"LH_LC"=lpv.LH_LC,"LH_CH"=lpv.LH_CH))

library(RColorBrewer)
color = colorRampPalette(rev(c(brewer.pal(n = 7, name ="RdBu"),"royalblue","darkblue")))(100)

# Making a heatmap with hierarchical clustering trees: 
save_plot(file="../../outputs/transcriptomics/ofav/kogmwu/KOG_urbanstress_ofav_host_treatment_lpv.pdf", width=7, height=8, {
  pheatmap(as.matrix(ktable),clustering_distance_cols="correlation",color=color, cellwidth=15, cellheight=15, border_color="white")
})

# exploring correlations between datasets
pairs(ktable, lower.panel = panel.smooth, upper.panel = panel.cor)
#scatterplots between pairs
# p-values of these correlations in the upper panel:
pairs(ktable, lower.panel = panel.smooth, upper.panel = panel.cor.pval)

# creating a pub-ready corr plot
save_plot(file="../../outputs/transcriptomics/ofav/kogmwu/KOG_urbanstress_ofav_host_treatment_corr_lpv.pdf", width=10, height=10, {
par(mfrow=c(4,4))
corrPlot(x="LC_CC",y="CH_CC",ktable)
corrPlot(x="LC_CC",y="LH_CC",ktable)
corrPlot(x="LC_CC",y="CH_LC",ktable)
corrPlot(x="LC_CC",y="LH_LC",ktable)
corrPlot(x="LC_CC",y="LH_CH",ktable)
corrPlot(x="CH_CC",y="LH_CC",ktable)
corrPlot(x="CH_CC",y="CH_LC",ktable)
corrPlot(x="CH_CC",y="LH_LC",ktable)
corrPlot(x="CH_CC",y="LH_CH",ktable)
corrPlot(x="LH_CC",y="CH_LC",ktable)
corrPlot(x="LH_CC",y="LH_LC",ktable)
corrPlot(x="LH_CC",y="LH_CH",ktable)
corrPlot(x="CH_LC",y="LH_LC",ktable)
corrPlot(x="CH_LC",y="LH_CH",ktable)
corrPlot(x="LH_LC",y="LH_CH",ktable)
})
```

# urban vs reef

```{r urban-vs-reef}
# urban vs reef DEGs come from the planned contrast from the site model in the limma script (urban_reef_lpv)
urban_reef=load('../../outputs/transcriptomics/ofav/limma/urban_reef_lpv.RData')
urban_reef # names of datasets in the package
urban_reef.p <- urban_reef.p[!is.na(urban_reef.p$lpv), ] # drop genes with NA lpv (e.g. padj = NA from independent filtering)
lpv.urban_reef=kog.mwu(urban_reef.p,gene2kog)
lpv.urban_reef

# loading stress treatment results for comparison
LC_CC=load('../../outputs/transcriptomics/ofav/limma/LC_CC_lpv.RData')
LC_CC.p <- LC_CC.p[!is.na(LC_CC.p$lpv), ] # drop genes with NA lpv (e.g. padj = NA from independent filtering)
lpv.LC_CC=kog.mwu(LC_CC.p,gene2kog)
CH_CC=load('../../outputs/transcriptomics/ofav/limma/CH_CC_lpv.RData')
CH_CC.p <- CH_CC.p[!is.na(CH_CC.p$lpv), ] # drop genes with NA lpv (e.g. padj = NA from independent filtering)
lpv.CH_CC=kog.mwu(CH_CC.p,gene2kog)
LH_CC=load('../../outputs/transcriptomics/ofav/limma/LH_CC_lpv.RData')
LH_CC.p <- LH_CC.p[!is.na(LH_CC.p$lpv), ] # drop genes with NA lpv (e.g. padj = NA from independent filtering)
lpv.LH_CC=kog.mwu(LH_CC.p,gene2kog)

# compiling a table of delta-ranks: does being urban resemble a stress response?
ktable=makeDeltaRanksTable(list("urban_reef"=lpv.urban_reef,"LC_CC"=lpv.LC_CC,"CH_CC"=lpv.CH_CC,"LH_CC"=lpv.LH_CC))

library(RColorBrewer)
color = colorRampPalette(rev(c(brewer.pal(n = 7, name ="RdBu"),"royalblue","darkblue")))(100)

# Making a heatmap with hierarchical clustering trees: 
save_plot(file="../../outputs/transcriptomics/ofav/kogmwu/KOG_urbanstress_ofav_host_urban_reef_lpv.pdf", width=7, height=8, {
  pheatmap(as.matrix(ktable),clustering_distance_cols="correlation",color=color, cellwidth=15, cellheight=15, border_color="white")
})

# exploring correlations between datasets
pairs(ktable, lower.panel = panel.smooth, upper.panel = panel.cor)
# p-values of these correlations in the upper panel:
pairs(ktable, lower.panel = panel.smooth, upper.panel = panel.cor.pval)

# creating a pub-ready corr plot
save_plot(file="../../outputs/transcriptomics/ofav/kogmwu/KOG_urbanstress_ofav_host_urban_reef_corr_lpv.pdf", width=7, height=2.5, {
par(mfrow=c(1,3))
corrPlot(x="urban_reef",y="LC_CC",ktable)
corrPlot(x="urban_reef",y="CH_CC",ktable)
corrPlot(x="urban_reef",y="LH_CC",ktable)
})
```


# sites

```{r site-pairwise}
# KOG enrichment for the site contrasts of the site model in the limma script: urban vs reef, each urban site vs the
# reef sites, and the six pairwise site comparisons (first site minus second). KOG-MWU ranks all genes, so it can be
# run for contrasts with few or no individually significant genes.
site_sets <- c("urban_reef", "MacN_reef", "Star_reef", "Rainbow_Emerald", "Star_Emerald", "MacN_Emerald",
               "Star_Rainbow", "MacN_Rainbow", "MacN_Star")
site_kog <- lapply(setNames(site_sets, site_sets), function(k) {
  d <- read.csv(paste0("../../outputs/transcriptomics/ofav/limma/", k, "_lpv.csv"))
  d <- d[!is.na(d$lpv), c("gene", "lpv")]
  kog.mwu(d, gene2kog)
})
ktable_site=makeDeltaRanksTable(site_kog)
ktable_site

library(RColorBrewer)
color = colorRampPalette(rev(c(brewer.pal(n = 7, name ="RdBu"),"royalblue","darkblue")))(100)

# heatmap with hierarchical clustering trees
save_plot(file="../../outputs/transcriptomics/ofav/kogmwu/KOG_urbanstress_ofav_host_sites_lpv.pdf", width=8, height=8, {
  pheatmap(as.matrix(ktable_site),clustering_distance_cols="correlation",color=color, cellwidth=15, cellheight=15, border_color="white")
})

# KOG classes significant in each site contrast (adjusted p < 0.05)
site_kog_sig <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(site_kog), function(k) {
  x <- site_kog[[k]]; x <- x[x$padj < 0.05, ]
  if (nrow(x)) data.frame(contrast = k, x, row.names = NULL) else NULL
}))
site_kog_sig
write.csv(ktable_site, file="../../outputs/transcriptomics/ofav/kogmwu/KOG_urbanstress_ofav_host_sites_delta_ranks.csv")
```
